verdict.rationale: Qodo's Agentic Toolbox ships first-party plugins for Claude Code and Codex (plus Kiro) explicitly for resolving code review findings. An MCP server also lets any agent retrieve and resolve review findings, so findings pass straight into the user's coding agent. Missing for 10: explicit Cursor integration docs, copyable per-finding fix prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the handoff works cleanly.
